Build prompt

Build “Study Group Flashcard & Practice Quiz Maker” on NeoApps for a study group leader. Turn uploaded notes into draft flashcards and quizzes. Let the group leader check each answer against its source. Use invitations and scope records to this group. Include a demo with fictional records. Use a configured model and show when the usage limit is reached.

Acceptance test

Generate a question from sample notes and edit its answer. The quiz uses the approved answer and links to the source excerpt.
